testcase.name: [CACHE-01] actual image bytes survive closing/reopening the database without expiry
[CACHE-01] one network miss produces a reusable payload; subsequent navigation-style loads make no request
[CACHE-02] LRU byte pressure removes oldest bytes, touches protect recent images and replacements do not inflate accounting
[CACHE-02] concurrent tab-style writers preserve atomic byte/count totals
[CACHE-03] clear invalidates in-flight generations and never accepts stale writes
[CACHE-03] unavailable storage and permission/network failures fall back without breaking loading
[CACHE-02] a quota failure prunes old data and retries once, then disables writes if quota remains exhausted
[CACHE-03] cancellation ignores late transport callbacks and cache reads; unsafe/unknown destinations do not use privileged requests
[CACHE-01] media pool stores only decoded successes and reads data URLs without re-training the host
[CACHE-03] corrupted cached bytes are invalidated and a forced retry bypasses saved images
